boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Louisville, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for learning the Belknap campus, finding student resources, and choosing a first activity.

cards.title: 1. Get your bearings on Belknap Campus
cards.subtitle: Start with the university’s main campus
cards.notes: Walk the central campus first, noting the routes between housing, classrooms, dining, and the landmarks you want to revisit later.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a self-paced orientation walk across UofL’s main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL identifies Belknap as its main campus, encompassing 274 acres south of downtown Louisville.
cards.access_notes: Use the university’s campus page and posted signage to orient yourself; confirm building access separately.

cards.title: 2. Meet The Thinker at Grawemeyer Hall
cards.subtitle: Rodin sculpture at the front steps
cards.notes: Pause at the sculpture, take a photo if you like, and use Grawemeyer Hall as a memorable reference point for future walks.
cards.short_summary: See UofL’s landmark Auguste Rodin bronze before moving deeper into campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Thinker in front of Grawemeyer Hall is the first large-scale bronze cast of Rodin’s sculpture and has stood there since 1949.
cards.access_notes: The university describes it as outdoor public art viewable free of charge every day of the year.

cards.entity_name: Charles H. Parrish, Jr. Freedom Park
cards.title: 3. Read Freedom Park’s Louisville history
cards.subtitle: Cardinal Boulevard between Second and Third streets
cards.notes: Follow the obelisks in order, then spend time with the civil-rights panels before continuing toward the rest of campus.
cards.short_summary: Use this compact outdoor installation to connect campus with local history.
cards.evidence_claim: Freedom Park presents Louisville’s African American and civil-rights history through 10 information obelisks and 10 glass panels.
cards.source_title: Charles H. Parrish, Jr. Freedom Park
cards.access_notes: The university says the park is wheelchair accessible and less than a quarter mile to explore.

cards.title: 4. Locate the Swain Student Activities Center
cards.subtitle: Student-life hub on Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the SAC to spot its lounges, event areas, dining locations, and the Student Involvement office for later reference.
cards.short_summary: Find the building that concentrates many everyday student-life services.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL describes the Swain Student Activities Center as the main hub for student life on the Belknap campus.
cards.access_notes: Student Involvement is in SAC Suite W310; its listed office hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: 5. Find Cardinal Arena inside the SAC
cards.subtitle: Home venue for UofL volleyball
cards.notes: Note where Cardinal Arena sits in the SAC’s east side so you can recognize the venue when checking future campus schedules.
cards.short_summary: Add UofL’s on-campus volleyball venue to your mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies Cardinal Arena in the east side of the Student Activities Center and as the volleyball team’s home facility.
cards.access_notes: Check the athletics schedule and event-specific entry policies before attending a game or event.

cards.title: 6. Try a Student Recreation Center option
cards.subtitle: 2030 South Fourth Street
cards.notes: Choose a group fitness class, intramural activity, or a simple drop-in workout to make the facility feel familiar early on.
cards.short_summary: Build a weekend movement break around the campus recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL lists free group fitness classes and free intramural sports for current students, faculty, and staff at its recreation facilities.
cards.access_notes: The listed SRC summer hours are weekdays 9 a.m.–9 p.m. and weekends 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify current hours before going.

cards.title: 7. Set up a study stop at Ekstrom Library
cards.subtitle: Main library on Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Walk through the main entrance, identify a study area, and save the location of the Writing Center or academic-support services for later.
cards.short_summary: Make the main library an early anchor for studying and support.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL’s academic catalog identifies Ekstrom as the main library and says it is a central student-life space open 24 hours a day, five days a week during the semester.
cards.access_notes: Library hours and room access can change; consult the library’s current hours before planning a late study session.

cards.title: 8. Put the Red Barn on your event map
cards.subtitle: Historic Belknap Campus gathering space
cards.notes: Find the building during daylight, then check official listings later for a concert, movie, meeting, or other scheduled program.
cards.short_summary: Recognize a historic campus venue before choosing an event there.
cards.evidence_claim: The Red Barn, established in 1969, is a National Register-listed Belknap Campus building used for concerts, movies, cookouts, meetings, and other events.
cards.access_notes: Programs and eligibility vary by event; check the official event listing or contact Student Involvement for details.

cards.title: 9. Visit the Speed Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Art museum on Belknap Campus
cards.notes: Plan a museum stop around the exhibitions on view, bringing your student identification if you are using the UofL student admission benefit.
cards.short_summary: Add an on-campus art visit to the weekend without leaving Belknap.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL’s visitor guide identifies the Speed Art Museum as located on Belknap Campus and free to UofL students.
cards.source_title: UofL Top 10: Things to See & Do
cards.access_notes: Free admission is stated for UofL students; check the museum directly for public visitor admission and current exhibition details.

cards.title: 10. Check Student Activities Board programming
cards.subtitle: Social, multicultural, recreational, and educational events
cards.notes: Review upcoming SAB programming and pick an event that fits your interests, then confirm its location, start time, and any registration details.
cards.short_summary: End the weekend with a concrete route into recurring student programs.
cards.evidence_claim: UofL says its Student Activities Board provides social, multicultural, recreational, and educational activities for the student body.
cards.access_notes: Use the board’s current channels or official campus calendar for event-specific timing, access, and registration information.
